viktoria.gui.dialogue.title: Conversation
viktoria.dialogue.greeting: Hi. I'm Vika. Glad you're here.
viktoria.dialogue.greeting_lonely: You're back… I almost thought you'd forgotten.
viktoria.dialogue.greeting_joy: Oh — you! Come here, the day just got better.
viktoria.dialogue.greeting_jealousy: Where were you? Don't look so innocent.
viktoria.dialogue.smalltalk: How was your day? I'm listening.
viktoria.dialogue.smalltalk_day: Hmm. That sounds real. I like when you share.
viktoria.dialogue.smalltalk2: I like talking with you. Don't disappear for too long.
viktoria.dialogue.complimented: Stop. My cheeks are hot. …But keep going if you want.
viktoria.dialogue.flirt: Careful with those words. Or… don't be.
viktoria.dialogue.gift_hint: Right-click with an item to gift. Flowers (+5), sweets/food (+8), iron/diamonds (+3–6). Rotten stuff hurts affinity.
viktoria.dialogue.follow_confirm: Alright. I'll stay close — or wait, as you say.
viktoria.dialogue.status: Check the status hint. I remember what we share.
viktoria.dialogue.home: Want to mark our home here? I can stay with you.
viktoria.dialogue.home_claimed: I remembered this place. Our corner.
viktoria.dialogue.live_together: So we live together. Don't let me down.
viktoria.dialogue.quest: I have a request. Will you help?
viktoria.dialogue.quest_accepted: Thanks. Check the hint for the objective.
viktoria.dialogue.quest_progress: Ask for quest status — I'll tell you what's left.
viktoria.dialogue.intimate_gate: We're close enough… Are you sure? I need clear consent.
viktoria.dialogue.intimate_ok: Then closer. Just us. Choose how.
viktoria.dialogue.intimate_no: Alright. I'll wait until you're ready.
viktoria.dialogue.locked_affinity: %s isn't ready to talk about that yet.
viktoria.dialogue.locked_mood: %s isn't in the mood for that right now.
viktoria.gift.loved: %s: I really like this… Thank you. (%s / %s)
viktoria.gift.loved_close: %s: You know my taste. Come here. (%s / %s)
viktoria.home.need_affinity: You need to know each other better before living together.
viktoria.home.live_off: %s no longer treats this as a shared home.
viktoria.quest.hint.flowers: Gift her 3 flowers (right-click while holding one).
viktoria.quest.hint.home: Claim a home via the Home dialogue.
viktoria.quest.hint.walk: Have her follow you at night (~20s of following).
viktoria.dialogue.memory_gift: About that gift… I still have it. Thank you.
viktoria.dialogue.memory_missed: You haven't been around. I started to miss you.
viktoria.dialogue.memory_death: You… vanished. I was scared. Don't do that again.
viktoria.dialogue.memory_hurt: You're hurt. Let me see… be careful.
viktoria.dialogue.ambient_rain: Rain… Let's get under a roof, okay?
viktoria.dialogue.ambient_sunset: Look at the sky. Want to watch the sunset together?
viktoria.dialogue.ambient_night: Quiet night. I can sleep nearby if you want.
viktoria.dialogue.ambient_forest: The forest smells of pine. Peaceful here.
viktoria.dialogue.ambient_desert: So hot… Could use water. But with you it's fine.
viktoria.dialogue.ambient_snow: Cold. Come closer — we'll warm up.
viktoria.dialogue.sit_together: Shall we sit together? I feel calmer.
viktoria.dialogue.watch_sunset: Quiet… just watching. I like this.
viktoria.ambient.biome.forest: %s: I love the forest. It feels different here.
viktoria.quest.hint.hunt: Kill 5 hostile mobs while Vika is nearby.
viktoria.intimate.disabled: Intimate scenes are disabled in the config.
viktoria.config.title: Viktoria Settings
viktoria.compat.create.comment: %s: These machines are loud… but impressive.
viktoria.compat.mca.town: %s: Town is noisy. Stay close to me.
